2) Search for guide: game "Battle Reign", condition "snowy weather", type maybe unspecified but we can leave empty or specify "strategy". But requirement says "find me a game guide for how to win in snowy weather conditions." So search with condition "snowy weather" and type ""? Might want type "strategy".

Also second request: find any strategy guides available for game Shadow Fall. That means search for game "Shadow Fall", type "strategy", no condition needed.

Thus three separate calls? Actually first update equipment; then two searches. We could combine into one response after calling each.

We'll use tool calls accordingly.

First call: BattleReignGameAPI_update_player_equipment with attribute="armor", level=5.

Second call: GameGuideAPI_search_guide with game="Battle Reign", condition="snowy weather", type="" or "strategy"? We'll choose type="strategy".
